senses.gloss: f. (denom. of preced.) woman engaged in the wine press, wine treader.—Pl. גִּתִּיּוֹת, גִּיתִּ׳.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> [read:] <he>אף הג׳ מאחורי הקוריים וכ׳</he> even the wine-treaders behind the beam handlers (of loose character) maligned her.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:11">Esth. R. to I, 10</cite> (play on <he>א̇ב̇ג̇ת̇א</he>) <he>א̇ב̇יא ג̇ית̇' מא׳ ק׳</he> I shall bring the wine treaders &c. (to deride her).
